item.tib: mdo sde dam pa yid bzhin nor bu las klu 'dul khyung sgrub rin chen me 'bar
item.coloph: ces pa'i mdo sde yid bzhin nor bu las dbal khyung dmar nag sgrub chog 'di ni mkha' 'gro bde chen dbang mo'i (mos) g.yu mtsho nas gter du drangs shing / phyis su mthong grol ri khrod khri 'dzin kun dga' rgyal mtshan tshul rgyal sku mched dang / stag bla seng nyi dang / g.yung drung rnam dag skyang mtshams g.yung drung rgyal mtshan rin rgyal sogs kyis bskul ngor/ mkha' 'gro'i ming 'dzin dbang mo'i (mos) shog ser la phab te spel ba'o// thog ma'i yi ge pa ni dngos slob g.yung drung dpal ldan gyis bgyis pas bstan pa yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/
